newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE MONDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE MONDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers; 36,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 27,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 200 Last Week - None Year Ago - 1,100
Wk to date - 36,200 Last Week - 26,600 Year Ago - 24,300
